decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly negative today with NASDAQ -0.8% and S&P 500 -0.3% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the $500 threshold for new positions, so per past lessons learned we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a buy.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted lower today in quiet trading, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, suggesting some rotation out of higher-growth names. No major catalyst emerged; this looks like routine consolidation after recent gains rather than a shift in trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和回落，NASDAQ跌0.8%，標普500跌0.3%，成交淡靜。NASDAQ跌幅較大，反映部分資金從高增長股份中流出，但暫未見重大利淡消息，較似是近期升勢後的整固。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. On neutral days like today, disciplined investors avoid forcing trades just to put cash to work — patience often pays off more than activity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留在場邊、待有明確機會時才動用的現金。在像今天這種市況不明朗的日子，有紀律的投資者不會為了「用錢」而勉強落單，耐心等待往往比盲目行動更有回報。
